summary: A 1935 10x10 cab on a log base in Lemhi County's Yellowjacket Mountains, unstaffed since the 1950s and last visited in 2010; a remote hike-in.

facts.status_note: Last reported standing in 2010; no later visit report was found.

visit.trail_note: 2010 visit report: 60 miles from the nearest paved road; 1.7 mile hike; road to the lookout fairly rough, best by ATV or dirt bike.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's 'standing' reflects the 2010 registration visit; the Idaho list's 'Abandoned' label describes use since the 1950s, not a confirmed collapse, so both can be true. No source reports a later condition.

notes_for_editor: Current condition unknown: the last visit report is 2010. Forest name conflict: the register says Salmon-Challis; firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts page and the Idaho list say Salmon National Forest. The record's height_m 3.0 has no source in the pages read; omitted. Log base year conflicts (1944 register, 1943 Idaho list). The 1950s dates are decade-only, so the 1950 event year is a placeholder. The 1982 history says the road never reached the lookout while the 2010 visit report describes a road to it; both are recorded. No access level is stated, so access is omitted. The 1982 history's 'fell into disuse before many of the Depression-era lookouts' is kept as a paraphrase without a 'were built' reading, which the excerpt does not support and which conflicts with the 1935 build and 1950s last use.
